generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A delivery packet can be internally self-consistent yet conflict with static gates on the published head or under-classify a canonical risk family implied by later reference consumption.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Treat result artifacts as outside repository checks and accept risk applicability labels without cross-checking the attack matrix or stale-reference signals.

reusable_control.rule: Before audit handoff, verify result-child compatibility with repository-wide static gates and cross-check active attack families against declared saturation.

generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Generate or exclude machine-produced handoff artifacts using the repository canonical static-check contract, and activate liveness when stale/obsolete references are consumed at a later definitive step.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Reject readiness when the published-head static gate fails or when risk-saturation applicability disagrees with attack-matrix families.

transfer_cases.evidence: Synthetic contract test asserts result-only handoff documentation requires repository-wide static-gate compatibility.
Synthetic auditor test rejects a family marked not-applicable when the attack matrix activates reference-liveness.

skill_changes.artifact: delivery handoff and liveness derivation contracts
